```{r}

# Get raster files and remove .tif extension for display
raster_files <- list.files(spatial_dir, pattern = '\\.tif$')
raster_names <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(raster_files)

# Remove city name from display names (case insensitive)
# city_string is loaded from setup.R
clean_names <- gsub(paste0(city_string, "[_-]?"), "", raster_names, ignore.case = TRUE)
clean_names <- gsub(paste0("[_-]?", city_string), "", clean_names, ignore.case = TRUE)

selectInput('layer', 'Select Rasters',
            choices = setNames(raster_files, clean_names),
            multiple = TRUE,
            selected = raster_files[1])

selectInput('x_column', 'X-axis', choices = c("area"), selected = "area")
selectInput('y_column', 'Y-axis', choices = c("area"), selected = "area")

hr()

actionButton('aggregate_btn', 'Aggregate Selected', class = 'btn-primary', width = '100%')
actionButton('reset_btn', 'Reset All', class = 'btn-warning', width = '100%')

htmlOutput('aggregate_info')

```

//| title: "Plot"

import {createScatterPlot} from "./js/scatterPlot.js"


// Transform polygon_data from R data frame to array of objects
plotData = transpose(polygon_data)

// Get all column names for tooltip
tooltipCols = Object.keys(plotData[0] || {})

// Create color mapping based on type
colorMap = {
  const colors = {};
  plotData.forEach(d => {
    if (d.type === "aggregated" && group_colors_map[d.name]) {
      colors[d.name] = group_colors_map[d.name];
    } else {
      colors[d.name] = "black";
    }
  });
  return colors;
}

// Add color field to data
plotDataWithColors = plotData.map(d => ({
  ...d,
  color: colorMap[d.name] || "black"
}))

plot = createScatterPlot(plotDataWithColors, {
  x: x_col,
  y: y_col,
  xLabel: x_col,
  yLabel: y_col,
  pointRadius: 6,
  opacity: 0.7,
  stroke: "white",
  fill: "color",
  tooltip: true,
  tooltipColumns: tooltipCols,
  height: 400,
  marginLeft: 70,
  marginBottom: 50,
  style: {
    background: "white",
    color: "black"
  }
})

```{r}
#| context: server

# Reactive value to store selected polygon IDs
selected_polygons <- reactiveVal(character(0))

# Reactive to store aggregated groups
# Structure: list of lists, each containing:
#   - name: group name (e.g., "Group 1")
#   - polygon_ids: vector of original polygon IDs
#   - geometry: dissolved geometry
aggregated_groups <- reactiveVal(list())

# Counter for group naming
group_counter <- reactiveVal(0)

# Colors for groups
group_colors <- c("#e41a1c", "#377eb8", "#4daf4a", "#984ea3", "#ff7f00",
                  "#ffff33", "#a65628", "#f781bf", "#999999")



# ----------------------------------
# ---------- REACTIVES -------------
# ----------------------------------

layers <- reactive({
    req(input$layer)
    # Load all selected rasters
    raster_list <- lapply(input$layer, function(lyr) {
        r <- rast(file.path(spatial_dir, lyr))
        # Reproject AOI to match raster CRS if needed
        aoi_reproj <- terra::project(aoi, crs(r))
        r %>% crop(aoi_reproj) %>% mask(aoi_reproj)
    })

    # Create clean names without city name
    base_names <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(input$layer)
    clean_names <- gsub(paste0(city_string, "[_-]?"), "", base_names, ignore.case = TRUE)
    clean_names <- gsub(paste0("[_-]?", city_string), "", clean_names, ignore.case = TRUE)

    names(raster_list) <- clean_names
    raster_list
})

# Calculate polygon statistics (including aggregated groups)
polygon_stats <- reactive({
    req(layers())
    raster_list <- layers()
    groups <- aggregated_groups()

    # Get all polygon IDs that are part of aggregated groups
    aggregated_ids <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) g$polygon_ids))

    # Calculate stats for non-aggregated wards
    non_aggregated_wards <- wards[!wards$DESA %in% aggregated_ids, ]

    if (nrow(non_aggregated_wards) > 0) {
        wards_reproj <- terra::project(non_aggregated_wards, crs(raster_list[[1]]))
        areas <- terra::expanse(wards_reproj, unit = "km")

        stats_df <- data.frame(
            name = non_aggregated_wards$DESA,
            area = areas,
            type = "individual"
        )

        # Extract values from each raster
        for (lyr_name in names(raster_list)) {
            r <- raster_list[[lyr_name]]
            wards_reproj <- terra::project(non_aggregated_wards, crs(r))
            extracted <- terra::extract(r, wards_reproj, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
            stats_df[[lyr_name]] <- extracted[[2]]
        }
    } else {
        stats_df <- data.frame(
            name = character(0),
            area = numeric(0),
            type = character(0)
        )
    }

    # Add aggregated groups
    if (length(groups) > 0) {
        for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
            group <- groups[[i]]
            group_geom <- group$geometry

            # Reproject for area calculation
            group_reproj <- terra::project(group_geom, crs(raster_list[[1]]))
            group_area <- terra::expanse(group_reproj, unit = "km")

            group_row <- data.frame(
                name = group$name,
                area = group_area,
                type = "aggregated"
            )

            # Extract values from each raster
            for (lyr_name in names(raster_list)) {
                r <- raster_list[[lyr_name]]
                group_reproj <- terra::project(group_geom, crs(r))
                extracted <- terra::extract(r, group_reproj, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
                group_row[[lyr_name]] <- extracted[[2]]
            }

            stats_df <- rbind(stats_df, group_row)
        }
    }

    stats_df
})

# Create reactive for selected data
selected_stats <- reactive({
    current_selection <- selected_polygons()
    stats <- polygon_stats()

    if (length(current_selection) > 0) {
        stats[stats$name %in% current_selection, ]
    } else {
        stats
    }
})




# --------------------------------
# ---------- MAPPING -------------
# --------------------------------

output$map <- renderLeaflet({
   map <- aoi %>%
    leaflet() %>%
    addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron)

   # Add all selected rasters with colors from layers.yml
   raster_list <- layers()
   for (i in seq_along(raster_list)) {
       layer_name <- names(raster_list)[i]
       r <- raster_list[[i]]

       # Find matching layer params
       layer_key <- NULL
       for (key in names(layer_params)) {
           param <- layer_params[[key]]
           if (!is.null(param$fuzzy_string)) {
               if (grepl(param$fuzzy_string, paste0(layer_name, ".tif"), perl = TRUE)) {
                   layer_key <- key
                   break
               }
           }
       }

       # Get color palette from layers.yml if available
       if (!is.null(layer_key) && !is.null(layer_params[[layer_key]]$palette)) {
           pal <- colorNumeric(
               palette = unlist(layer_params[[layer_key]]$palette),
               domain = values(r),
               na.color = "transparent"
           )
           map <- map %>% addRasterImage(r, colors = pal, group = layer_name, opacity = 0.7)
       } else {
           # Use default palette if no match found
           map <- map %>% addRasterImage(r, group = layer_name, opacity = 0.7)
       }
   }

   # Add polygons
   map <- map %>%
    addPolygons(
      data = wards,
      layerId = ~DESA,
      popup = ~DESA,
      color = 'white',
      weight = 1,
      fillOpacity = 0.2,
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        color = 'cyan',
        weight = 3,
        fillColor = 'cyan',
        fillOpacity = 0.5,
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    )

   # Add layer control if multiple rasters
   if (length(raster_list) > 1) {
       map <- map %>% addLayersControl(
           overlayGroups = names(raster_list),
           options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
       )
   }

   map
})


# ---------------------------------
# ---------- OBSERVER -------------
# ---------------------------------

# ----- Click Additive Selection --------
observeEvent(input$map_shape_click, {
  click <- input$map_shape_click

  if (!is.null(click$id)) {
    current_selection <- selected_polygons()

    # Toggle selection: add if not selected, remove if already selected
    if (click$id %in% current_selection) {
      selected_polygons(setdiff(current_selection, click$id))
    } else {
      selected_polygons(c(current_selection, click$id))
    }
  }
})

# ----- Reset Click Outside Polygon --------
observeEvent(input$map_click, {
  selected_polygons(character(0))
})

# ----- Aggregate Additive Selection --------
observeEvent(input$aggregate_btn, {
  current_selection <- selected_polygons()

  if (length(current_selection) == 0) {
    showNotification("Please select polygons to aggregate", type = "warning")
    return()
  }

  # Increment group counter
  counter <- group_counter() + 1
  group_counter(counter)

  # Get selected ward geometries
  selected_wards <- wards[wards$DESA %in% current_selection, ]

  # Dissolve/union the geometries
  dissolved_geom <- terra::aggregate(selected_wards)

  # Create new group
  new_group <- list(
    name = paste0("Group ", counter),
    polygon_ids = current_selection,
    geometry = dissolved_geom,
    color = group_colors[(counter - 1) %% length(group_colors) + 1]
  )

  # Add to aggregated groups
  groups <- aggregated_groups()
  groups[[length(groups) + 1]] <- new_group
  aggregated_groups(groups)

  # Clear selection
  selected_polygons(character(0))

  showNotification(paste0("Created ", new_group$name, " with ", length(current_selection), " polygons"), type = "message")
})

# ----- Reset Additive Selection --------
observeEvent(input$reset_btn, {
  aggregated_groups(list())
  group_counter(0)
  selected_polygons(character(0))
  showNotification("Reset all aggregations", type = "message")
})


# ----- UPDATE POLYGONS BASED ON AGGREGATION --------
observeEvent(list(selected_polygons(), aggregated_groups()), {
  current_selection <- selected_polygons()
  groups <- aggregated_groups()

  # Get all polygon IDs that are part of aggregated groups
  aggregated_ids <- unlist(lapply(groups, function(g) g$polygon_ids))

  # Clear and redraw all polygons with updated styling
  map_proxy <- leafletProxy('map') %>%
    clearShapes()

  # Add base ward polygons (not aggregated)
  non_aggregated_wards <- wards[!wards$DESA %in% aggregated_ids, ]
  if (nrow(non_aggregated_wards) > 0) {
    map_proxy <- map_proxy %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = non_aggregated_wards,
        layerId = ~DESA,
        popup = ~DESA,
        color = ~ifelse(DESA %in% current_selection, 'cyan', 'white'),
        weight = ~ifelse(DESA %in% current_selection, 3, 1),
        fillColor = ~ifelse(DESA %in% current_selection, 'cyan', NA),
        fillOpacity = ~ifelse(DESA %in% current_selection, 0.5, 0.2),
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
          color = 'cyan',
          weight = 3,
          fillColor = 'cyan',
          fillOpacity = 0.5,
          bringToFront = TRUE
        )
      )
  }

  # Add aggregated group polygons
  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    group <- groups[[i]]
    map_proxy <- map_proxy %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = group$geometry,
        layerId = paste0("group_", i),
        popup = paste0(group$name, "<br>", length(group$polygon_ids), " polygons"),
        color = group$color,
        weight = 3,
        fillColor = group$color,
        fillOpacity = 0.4,
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
          color = group$color,
          weight = 5,
          fillOpacity = 0.6,
          bringToFront = TRUE
        )
      )
  }
})



# ----- AGGREGATION SELECTION --------
output$aggregate_info <- renderText({
  groups <- aggregated_groups()
  if (length(groups) == 0) {
    return("<p style='color: #666;'>No aggregated groups yet</p>")
  }

  info_html <- "<div style='margin-top: 10px;'>"
  info_html <- paste0(info_html, "<p><strong>Aggregated Groups:</strong></p>")
  for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
    group <- groups[[i]]
    info_html <- paste0(info_html,
                       "<p style='margin: 5px 0;'>",
                       "<span style='display:inline-block; width:15px; height:15px; background-color:",
                       group$color, "; margin-right:5px; border: 1px solid #333;'></span>",
                       group$name, " (", length(group$polygon_ids), " polygons)</p>")
  }
  info_html <- paste0(info_html, "</div>")
  info_html
})


# ----- OBSERVER FOR PLOT --------
observeEvent(polygon_stats(), {
    stats <- polygon_stats()
    # All columns except name and type
    column_choices <- setdiff(names(stats), c("name", "type"))

    # Find first raster column (not area)
    raster_cols <- setdiff(column_choices, "area")
    default_y <- if(length(raster_cols) > 0) raster_cols[1] else "area"

    updateSelectInput(session, "x_column", choices = column_choices, selected = "area")
    updateSelectInput(session, "y_column", choices = column_choices, selected = default_y)
})

# Pass data to OJS including group colors
ojs_define(
    polygon_data = reactive({ selected_stats() }),
    x_col = reactive({ input$x_column }),
    y_col = reactive({ input$y_column }),
    group_colors_map = reactive({
        groups <- aggregated_groups()
        if (length(groups) == 0) return(list())

        color_map <- list()
        for (i in seq_along(groups)) {
            color_map[[groups[[i]]$name]] <- groups[[i]]$color
        }
        color_map
    })
)
```
